title: Target affine Leray comparison compatible with a natural source Ext comparison
statement:
Let f : X → S be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes and g : S′ → S any morphism [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let F be a quasi-coherent module on X, I an injective resolution of F, and J an injective resolution of g′*F, where g′ = pullback.snd g f [def-pc-module-pullback, pqf-def-cohomology]. Fix p in N, affine opens V of S and W of S′ with W contained in g inverse V, and restricted resolution choices D [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write A = Gamma(S,V), B = Gamma(S′,W), U = f inverse V, h : U → Spec A for the affine chart morphism, N = F pulled back to U, and Q = R^p f′_*g′*F. There exists a family E_M of additive equivalences from module cohomology of M on U to Ext cohomology H(M,p), natural in every module morphism. Define e0 by E at F restricted to U followed by the cohomology map of the canonical restriction/pullback isomorphism. There exists a B-linear equivalence b : HOver(h_B,N_B,p) → Gamma(Q,W) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] such that b(baseChangeLinear(e0(x))) equals the restriction to W of D.targetClass(moduleCohomologyFMap(D.psi)(x)) for every module cohomology class x [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No flatness is assumed. This constructs only the target affine equivalence and its normalization, not a source tensor comparison.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem exists_flatBaseChange_target_leray_comparison
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) := (g.appLE V W eVW).hom.toAlgebra
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let Q := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)
    ∃ E : ∀ M : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Modules,
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj M) ≃+
          H M p,
      (∀ (M M' : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Modules) (φ : M ⟶ M')
        (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj M),
        E M' (((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).map φ).hom x) = H.map φ p (E M x)) ∧
      (∃ e0 : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
            (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)) ≃+ HOver h N p,
         e0 = (E ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)).trans
            (H.mapLinearEquiv ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).app F) p).toAddEquiv ∧
       ∃ b : HOver (baseChangeSnd (S := Γ(S', W)) h)
           (baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N) p ≃ₗ[Γ(S', W)] Γ(Q, W),
         ∀ xi : HOver h N p,
           b (H.baseChangeLinear (S := Γ(S', W)) h N p xi) =
             Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
               (D.targetClass p
                 (moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                   ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p (e0.symm xi))))

source.place: Affine cohomology dictionary in the first proof paragraph; Tags 01XK, 01XJ, 01E4 and 03FD for the target Leray edge and common-complex normalization.

proof.text: Apply the module/Ext scalar-extension comparison to h and B. Obtain natural source and target families E and E prime, and compatibility with the module cohomology map of baseChangeUnit. Set e0 to E at the restricted F followed by the cohomology equivalence of restrictFunctorIsoPullback.
Apply the module target Leray comparison with E prime and its coefficient naturality. This provides b and its formula on every source module cohomology class x.

For xi put x=e0 inverse(xi). Naturality of E at the restriction/pullback morphism identifies E_N(H_mod(c)(x)) with xi: its right side is e0(x)=xi. Apply the scalar-extension compatibility to H_mod(c)(x). Apply b to this equality and compose it with the normalized module Leray formula. This yields precisely the original displayed equality, and packages the chosen E and e0 with their naturality and defining equality. The Lean proof uses only these equivalences and equality transitivity.

proof_origin.place: Existing steps 1-3 separated into comparison of the unit map in two cohomology models and normalized module-cohomology target Leray; the original conclusion is combined by coefficient naturality and equality transitivity.
